title: Aligned but Not Partner-Specific: How Multimodal LLM Agents Succeed in Reference Games Without Forming Conceptual Pacts
abstract: arXiv:2606.08081v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Repeated reference games test whether interlocutors replace their initially long descriptions with shorter, partner-specific expressions grounded in shared interaction history; that is, with conceptual pacts. Prior work shows that multimodal LLMs fail to become more efficient across rounds, although they align on the labels they use. However, how can we determine whether this alignment reflects partner-specific grounding rather than a shared task vocabulary? We address this by comparing competent multimodal agent dyads with human dyads from the KTH Tangrams corpus. Our novel methodological contribution is a pragmatically constrained pseudo-dyad baseline: rounds from two different real dyads describing the same target at comparable trajectory positions are paired, preserving referential task structure while removing shared partner history. translated_title: 对齐但非伙伴特异：多模态LLM智能体如何在未形成概念协约的情况下成功完成指称博弈
translated_abstract: arXiv:2606.08081v2 公告类型：replace-cross。摘要：重复指称博弈检验对话者是否会用基于共享互动历史、更简短且针对特定伙伴的表达来替代最初冗长的描述，即是否会形成“概念协约”。已有研究表明，多模态大语言模型（LLM）在多轮对话中未能变得更加高效，尽管它们在所使用的标签上趋于一致。然而，我们如何判断这种对齐反映的是针对特定伙伴的语境锚定，而不仅仅是共享的任务词汇？为此，我们将能力合格的多模态智能体组合与KTH Tangrams语料库中的人类组合进行比较。我们的新方法论贡献是一个语用约束的伪组合基线：将来自两个不同真实组合、在相近轨迹位置描述同一目标的轮次进行配对，在保留指称任务结构的同时去除共享的伙伴历史。这使我们能够检验所观察到的标签对齐是否依赖于与特定伙伴的互动……（原文摘要至此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种“语用约束伪组合”基线方法，通过配对不同真实组合在相近轨迹位置描述同一目标的对话轮次，在保留任务结构的同时剥离伙伴历史，从而发现多模态LLM智能体在指称博弈中虽能达到标签对齐，却并未形成依赖特定互动历史的“概念协约”。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces a pragmatically constrained pseudo-dyad baseline and demonstrates that multimodal LLM agents achieve label alignment in reference games without forming genuine partner-specific conceptual pacts.
